choices.choiceText: Met some but not all expectations

value.stringValue: Met some but not all expectations

formulas.name: formAttendance
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Attendance}), "", "- " & CASE( {!Attendance}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Perfect reliability and flexibility; consistently available.", "Exceeded expectations", "Very reliable attendance and timeliness.", "Fully met expectations", "Meets attendance and punctuality expectations.", "Met some but not all expectations", "Occasional issues with attendance or punctuality.", "Did not meet expectations", "Unreliable attendance or frequent tardiness.", "" ))

formulas.name: formCommunication
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Communication}), "", "- " & CASE( {!Communication}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Clear, influential communicator; elevates team alignment.", "Exceeded expectations", "Consistently clear and timely communication.", "Fully met expectations", "Communicates effectively as needed.", "Met some but not all expectations", "Clarity or timeliness issues at times.", "Did not meet expectations", "Communication is unclear, delayed, or insufficient.", "" ))

formulas.name: formCustomer_Service
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Customer_Service}), "", "- " & CASE( {!Customer_Service}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Delivers exceptional service; anticipates customer needs.", "Exceeded expectations", "Consistently provides high-quality, responsive service.", "Fully met expectations", "Meets service expectations and resolves issues.", "Met some but not all expectations", "Service is uneven; follow-up or empathy needs improvement.", "Did not meet expectations", "Service falls short; issues remain unresolved.", "" ))

formulas.name: formGeneral_Performance
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!General_Performance}), "", "- " & CASE( {!General_Performance}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Outstanding performance — consistently surpasses all requirements.", "Exceeded expectations", "Strong performance that goes above standard expectations.", "Fully met expectations", "Performance meets all requirements as expected.", "Met some but not all expectations", "Performance met some goals but needs improvement in key areas.", "Did not meet expectations", "Performance fell short of required standards.", "" ))

formulas.name: formInitiative_Rating
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Initiative_Rating}), "", "- " & CASE( {!Initiative_Rating}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Proactively drives improvements and takes ownership.", "Exceeded expectations", "Frequently takes initiative with minimal direction.", "Fully met expectations", "Takes initiative when appropriate.", "Met some but not all expectations", "Requires prompting to take action; follow-through varies.", "Did not meet expectations", "Seldom shows initiative or ownership.", "" ))

formulas.name: formJob_Knowledge
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Job_Knowledge}), "", "- " & CASE( {!Job_Knowledge}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Expert-level knowledge; anticipates and solves complex issues.", "Exceeded expectations", "Solid depth of knowledge beyond role requirements.", "Fully met expectations", "Adequate knowledge applied reliably.", "Met some but not all expectations", "Some gaps in knowledge/application; coaching recommended.", "Did not meet expectations", "Insufficient knowledge for role responsibilities.", "" ))

formulas.name: formPerformance_Results
formulas.expression:
CASE( {!Performance_Results}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Delivered exceptional results, consistently surpassing every performance target and demonstrating outstanding impact.",
"Exceeded expectations", "Delivered strong and consistent results that went above expectations, often identifying ways to improve performance outcomes.",
"Fully met expectations", "Successfully achieved all assigned goals and performance objectives, maintaining a steady and reliable level of contribution.",
"Met some but not all expectations", "Achieved several objectives but missed key performance targets, indicating areas that require focus and improvement going forward.",
"Did not meet expectations", "Did not achieve expected results or meet key goals, showing a need for significant improvement and stronger performance consistency.",
"" )

formulas.name: formPIPNeeded
formulas.expression: OR( {!General_Performance} = "Met some but not all expectations", {!General_Performance} = "Did not meet expectations", {!Job_Knowledge} = "Met some but not all expectations", {!Job_Knowledge} = "Did not meet expectations", {!Work_Quality} = "Met some but not all expectations", {!Work_Quality} = "Did not meet expectations", {!Attendance} = "Met some but not all expectations", {!Attendance} = "Did not meet expectations", {!Initiative_Rating} = "Met some but not all expectations", {!Initiative_Rating} = "Did not meet expectations", {!Communication} = "Met some but not all expectations", {!Communication} = "Did not meet expectations", {!Customer_Service} = "Met some but not all expectations", {!Customer_Service} = "Did not meet expectations" )

formulas.name: formWork_Quality
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!Work_Quality}), "", "- " & CASE( {!Work_Quality}, "Significantly exceeded expectations", "Exceptional accuracy and craftsmanship; sets the bar.", "Exceeded expectations", "High-quality deliverables with minimal rework.", "Fully met expectations", "Consistently accurate and complete.", "Met some but not all expectations", "Quality varies; errors or rework needed at times.", "Did not meet expectations", "Frequent errors; does not meet standards.", "" ))
